parts.text: The figure shows the **Transformer’s encoder–decoder architecture**. The encoder (left) consists of \(N=6\) repeated layers, each combining multi-head self-attention with a position-wise feed-forward network

citations.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.

parts.text: . The decoder (right) adds masked self-attention—preventing access to future tokens—and attention over the encoder’s output

citations.quote: the decoder inserts a third sub-layer, which performs multi-head attention over the output of the encoder stack.

parts.text:
.

Input and shifted-output embeddings are combined with positional encodings to represent token order

citations.quote: we add "positional encodings" to the input embeddings at the bottoms of the encoder and decoder stacks.

parts.text: . Residual “Add & Norm” connections surround each sublayer, while the final linear layer and softmax produce next-token probabilities

citations.quote: softmax function to convert the decoder output to predicted next-token probabilities.
